summary: NCL Corporation Ltd., the Bermuda-incorporated subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings, filed an 8-K reporting the October 15, 2026 closing of a $950.0 million private offering of 8.750% senior notes due 2031, netting roughly $941.7 million after initial purchaser discount. Proceeds plus cash on hand funded redemption of the 6.125% 2028 notes issued by NCL Finance, repayment of about $376.3 million under its senior secured revolving facility, and prepayment of roughly $42.2 million of export-credit-backed borrowings. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch cruise-sector credit spreads and covenant headroom.
